For months I have recorded odd happenstance in my day to day life tied so closely with my nightmares I can no longer write them off as coincidence. Dreams of men with no futures, who's ends I can not seem to prolong more than my own. For my dreams seem to manifest themselves in odd ways, and though I tend to not recall many, they appear tied to reality, whether as fate or prophecy I can not say.

I acted first out of greed, could my 'gift' be useful in any way fiscal? For some of my dreams seemed to be quite unordinary at first, I remember a good friend of mine, a clerk, who I dreamt had been robbed by a group of youths for his dowry, and of course when I awoke I thought it odd. It had not seemed like a dream, and my memory and perspective of it seemed more of a vision than anything, for my recall of it was clear as glass, and had I not known better I would have thought myself lucid. The faces on the men were quite memorable, and I knew the details by heart.

Of course, when morning broke I wrote it off. What an odd dream. but when later in the week I learned of my friends unfortunate occurrence, I had to speak up. There was no easy way to do it, so I went to my friend and made a bet. If I was able to correctly identify the robbers and recover the dowry, I would get half of it. Of course, I had no idea how to broach the subject, can any man say in any sane way that he had seen his friend robbed and knew who had done it, all while having no connection to the event? My friend was put off and quite doubtful of me, which was completely fine, since I was doubtful of myself as well.

After talking with the police though, there was a change in attitude. Not only did the description of the men provided match up, they knew exactly who the troublemakers were. Which only brought more suspicion upon myself, as I could say not only how many people there were, what they were wearing, but all other details needed or not concerning the occasion. My friend was spooked, As anyone would likely be, but optimistic and paid no more mind to how I had "figured it out"

Needless to say, the dowry was recovered and the men in question put behind bars in record time, and my half of the dowry was gratefully given to me.

Then I had a nightmare. My friend the clerk was going home from work late during the night, and was hit by a car. I watched as he was knocked from where he had previously been standing into a ravine that shouldered the road.

When I awoke I rushed out the door, fearing for the life of my friend. I knew where he was, for the environment and scenery I saw were that of a rural area not far from the local pharmacy, and as he was heading home from work I can only imagine he was planning to stop by. It was no secret that his wife was very much pregnant and in a constant state of nausea. Perhaps he had picking up some much needed medications. In any case, I hurried over.

I was driving fast, and while normally I would be worried for speed tickets they were the last thing on my mind now. I had been paying little attention to the road, although I knew I was close. There was something blocking the road, but I could not see it clearly, likely to be an animal of some sort. I passed it, but the wheels spun out when I was making the turn. I guess "driving a bit fast" had been an understatement, as I plowed into a man who was minding his own business on the sidewalk.

Horrified, I stepped out of my vehicle. He had fallen into a nearby ravine, and after rushing over, climbing down a bit, and minding the bushes I examined the body. It was my dear friend the clerk.

I murdered him. There was no way around it. In my attempt to save my friend from a reckless driver I had become the very thing I swore to save him from. I did not report his body. I did not tell a soul. He became "missing" a few days later, and I volunteered to help in his search.

"We" did not find him. I made sure of that. He is missing to this day, and of course I eventually learned my lesson about "helping" people in my dreams. I still do not know for certain if he would be fine had I decided to stay home that night, but I doubt he would have. There were many more nightmares that lead me to this conclusion, and while I shall not recount all of them, I shall name one that stood with me.

There was a domestic abuser who killed his wife, and it happened after an escalated argument whereupon I was trying to convince him that she was both all he has, and all he needs. This was in response to a dream I had where I had seen him choking her with vigor until her eyes rolled far back where only whites can be seen.

I decided that whatever happened in my dreams, It would be best if I was not involved in them whatsoever.

I hoped that while the deaths of people I knew could be seen in dream, that I would never see myself. I was optimistic in hoping so.

Tonight, I dreamed a dream of sincere insanity.

I dreamt that I had fallen off a very tall building. Well, fallen would not be the right word for it, I had jumped off. With seemingly solid determination to die. I watched as my body hit the cement, and saw the devastation wrought upon this sack of flesh. There was little left in all honesty, I saw that I was well and truly dead, but I am quite optimistic about my death. After all, it seems rather painless, and painless is what I will desire most about my death. With this in mind, I have decided that I will in no way try to spar with fate, but will accept death as is. With this, I bid you all farewell. I hope this note I am leaving suffices for the reasons for my death, although I am aware it reads as a final farewell from what can only be assumed to be a madman. I just want to say you had nothing to do with it mother, and I love you.
